_comment: Lines by trigger. A trigger is a list of lines, or {"anim": default reaction, "lines": [...]}. A line is a string or {"text", "anim", "when", "weight"}. "when" can test time (morning, afternoon, evening, night), level / level_min / level_max (affection level 0-4), mood (today's check-in answer), outfit and memory (an unlocked memory id). Lists mean any of them.
